calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-01-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change and Gender Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Mars Goodman and Shawna Van Tree, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.
Petitioner Jose Lorenzo Rodriguez de German present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined through Spanish Interpreter Claudia Cabrera-Lara.
Proof of Publication and Declaration of Sworn Physician on file.

No objections to the proposed change of name and gender were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations of the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Name Change to Lorena Rodriguez and Gender from male to female.
Decree changing Name and Gender signed by the court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-09-2013 Reset To Aug-01-13 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 514 For Order To Show Cause
